title: Chronodynamic Relativity: Unified Relativistic & Cosmological Empirical Evaluation Framework
description: The official reproduction codebase and empirical evaluation framework for Chronodynamic Relativity. Unifies linear cosmic expansion (Pantheon+ SNe Ia), CMB acoustic hierarchy (Planck 2018 PR3), galactic rotation curves (SPARC 175 galaxies), and cluster collision dynamics (Bullet Cluster) from first principles.
